notes.title: World of Unlit is out!
notes.notes:
After a little over two years of development, 10 exciting videos, and more than 257,000 views, World of Unlit is finally here! You can now buy and play the game on Steam and immerse yourself in its action-packed world.

[b]Price:[/b]

[list]
[*]     $14.99 USD
[/list]

[b]What to Expect:[/b]

[list]
[*]     8 thrilling missions
[*]     Over 50 unique weapons
[*]     A competitive leaderboard system to help you achieve the best times
[*]     28 achievements to unlock—ranging from easy to challenging
[/list]

A huge thank you to everyone who supported and contributed to this project—CamelT for making the soundtrack , RJ Enoz for helping with modelling , Henry Rosales for making the UI & Suncytia for the cover art but also to all the beta testers. Your help made [b]World of Unlit[/b] possible!

[b]Fun Facts:[/b]
[list]
[*] The game was initially supposed to be just a 10 day break from another project. I don't remember how it happened but now 2 years later there is World of Unlit.
[*] The second mission (Tirie) was initially just a prototyping area but turns out it's actually great as it's own mission
[*] Edge Lake was called "Nasty" for the longest time during development
[*] There is a big Discord Community around World of Unlit where everyone interested in World of Unlit can join
[/list]

And that's not all—keep an eye out for the [b]World of Unlit Original Soundtrack (OST)[/b], which will be launching soon on Steam.

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to see how you fare in the world of Unlit!
